On 2026-10-02, Associated Press reported “Brazil’s leading presidential candidates snub TV debate ahead of Sunday’s election”; on the same day, Al Jazeera reported “Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and his main opponent Flavio Bolsonaro have snubbed a chance at a final debate ahead of the first round of the presidential election on Sunday, while police ruled out a bomb threat outside the country’s Supreme Court.”.

On 2026-10-02, Associated Press reported “Brazil’s leading presidential candidates snub TV debate ahead of Sunday’s election”; on the same day, Al Jazeera reported “TV Globo said in a statement that the debate was cancelled because two rulings, one from the country’s electoral court and the other from the Supreme Court, had created “legal uncertainty” about the event.”.

On 2026-10-02, Associated Press reported “The broadcaster said in a statement that the debate was canceled because two rulings, one from the country’s electoral court and the other from Brazil’s Supreme Court, had created “legal uncertainty” about the event.”; on the same day, Al Jazeera reported “TV Globo said in a statement that the debate was cancelled because two rulings, one from the country’s electoral court and the other from the Supreme Court, had created “legal uncertainty” about the event.”.
